pages.title: Privacy policy
pages.lead: How information submitted through this website is handled.

blocks.text: Information you provide

Contact, quotation and calculator forms collect your name, email, phone number and the business or project information you choose to share. Quotation attachments may contain artwork or reference material. Avoid uploading personal documents or information unrelated to your enquiry.
How information is used

Submitted information is stored to review your requirement, prepare a quotation and respond to you. Automated acknowledgement and internal notification emails may be sent when email delivery is configured. Submitting a form does not place an order.
Storage and service providers

The application uses a database for submissions and restricted file storage for attachments. Hosting, database, file storage and email providers may process information for these purposes. Access to private submissions and attachments is restricted to authorised integrations.
Retention and requests

Contact info@parasprints.com to ask about access, correction or deletion of information you have submitted. The company must confirm its retention schedule and any recordkeeping obligations. No fixed retention period is asserted here.
Cookies and analytics

The calculator uses session storage on your device to retain your specifications during navigation. Essential form and upload interactions do not require advertising cookies. Optional analytics runs only after you choose to allow it, when configured. You can revisit your choice using the Analytics preferences link in the footer.
Policy review
This policy describes the implemented website data flows. The company should review its legal identity, provider arrangements and retention practices before a public launch.

Measure the product as it will be packed, including inserts, cushioning and accessories. Record length, width and height with a clear unit. State whether dimensions describe the inside of the carton or the finished outer pack.
Explain the journey

Describe how goods will be stored, handled and delivered. Include the packed weight, the number of items per carton and the proposed closure. Ask the manufacturer which samples or checks are appropriate.
Separate structure from artwork

Share a structural reference alongside the latest artwork. Identify colours, print positions and finishes you would like reviewed. Flag anything that is still a preference rather than an approved specification.
Make the commercial brief complete
Include quantity, delivery city and the date you would like to discuss. Ask for minimum order requirements, pricing, lead time and sample approval to be confirmed in writing.

blogs.author: Editorial guide

content.text: Give the document a job
Decide whether the piece introduces a business, supports a sales conversation or documents a product range. Use that purpose to plan a reading order and an approximate amount of content.
Plan pages and panels

For a folded brochure, describe the flat size and finished size. For a catalogue, provide the page count including the cover and identify whether it uses a separate stock. Ask the printer to confirm fold and binding suitability.
Prepare the production information
Include finished size, quantity, artwork status, paper preferences and proposed finishes. Ask for a proof and approval process rather than assuming every finish suits every paper.
Review before release
Check product names, contact information, image permissions and final text. Mark the approved artwork version clearly so the quotation and production discussion refer to the same document.

blogs.title: Plan an e-commerce pack around the whole journey.

blogs.author: Editorial guide

content.text: Consider the packing sequence
Describe how the product is placed, protected, closed and identified. Include accessories and printed inserts in your dimensions rather than considering the bare product alone.
Discuss handling and presentation together
Share the intended shipping method and the presentation you want the recipient to see. Ask the manufacturer to review the structure, material and print requirements as one specification.
Use a sample to ask better questions
A physical sample can support a discussion about fit, closure and packing. Agree any transport or performance checks with the company for the actual product; a picture cannot establish performance.
Confirm the order-specific details
Request written confirmation of quantity, board, artwork, production schedule and delivery arrangements. Avoid treating a general product description as a final specification.

faqs.question: Can packaging be customised?
faqs.answer: The published portfolio includes corrugated boxes, duplex monocartons and paper bags. Share your product, dimensions, artwork and intended use so the team can confirm a suitable configuration.

faqs.question: What is the minimum order quantity?
faqs.answer: A single verified minimum order quantity is not available. Include your required quantity in your enquiry; the team will confirm production suitability and pricing.

faqs.question: What should I include in a quotation request?
faqs.answer: Send the product category, quantity, dimensions with units, material preferences, printing and finishing requirements, delivery city and artwork if available.

faqs.question: Which printing options are listed?
faqs.answer: The published product information describes offset printing for commercial print and printed packaging. The exact colour, paper and finishing combination will be confirmed for your job.

faqs.question: Can I request a material recommendation?
faqs.answer: Yes. Describe the product weight, packing method, handling and storage conditions in your enquiry. Ask the team to recommend the board or paper rather than choosing solely on appearance.

faqs.question: Does the calculator give a final selling price?
faqs.answer: No approved rate card has been supplied. The calculator records your specifications for a reviewed quotation and does not invent a price.

faqs.question: When will my order be delivered?
faqs.answer: Delivery depends on the approved specification, artwork, quantity and destination. Ask the team to confirm a schedule in your written quotation.

faqs.question: How can I share artwork?
faqs.answer: Attach up to three JPG, PNG or PDF files, each no larger than 10 MB, to a quotation request. These are website upload limits, not manufacturing specifications.

faqs.question: Can I visit the facility?
faqs.answer: Contact the team before travelling to confirm the current visit address and appointment availability. The source site publishes conflicting location details.

faqs.question: Are company certificates available to download?
faqs.answer: Verified certificate copies were not supplied. Ask the company for current documentation relevant to your requirement.
